label: challenging
title: Unlimited liability describing a superseded agreement

pages.text:
SETTLEMENT AND RELEASE

Between Riverbank Corp and Stonefield LLC.

Recitals. WHEREAS the Prior Agreement imposed unlimited liability on Riverbank for legacy claims;

Section 1. Release. The parties release all legacy claims. Section 2. Cap. Liability under this settlement is capped at $250,000.

Signed. Signature: Omar Neil. Signature: Pia Wells.

expected.rationale: 'Unlimited liability' describes the superseded prior agreement in a recital; the operative settlement terms cap liability at $250,000. Keyword matchers will false-positive here; that error is fairly scored.
